first.rationale: Test a shorter onboarding flow first because completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, making onboarding a likely upstream constraint. Prior evidence suggests shorter onboarding improves time-to-value, while activation messaging may improve engagement but may not address completion loss. Use a guarded test with stop conditions on qualified activation, retention, and pipeline quality so increased completion does not come at the expense of sustainable revenue or lead quality.

final.rationale: Run a guarded shorter-onboarding experiment because completion is down 4% and onboarding is an upstream driver of activation. The verified result showed +13% completion, 2.1 fewer days to value, and +3% 30-day retention, making it the strongest evidence for sustainable qualified revenue. Monitor qualified activation, 30-day retention, conversion quality, and revenue; stop if downstream value or lead quality declines despite higher completion.
